Hi Olivia 


Great questions; answers below and added Marcus (lead, reliability) to help with specifics.

1) Rate limits / burst:
- Hosted (shared) tenants: baseline per-tenant soft limit is 500 rps. We allow short bursts up to ~2k rps for 30s using an adaptive token bucket; longer sustained higher throughput is best served with a Dedicated pool.
- Dedicated: configurable baseline (example: 1k rps steady with 5k rps short bursts depending on pool size).

2) Failover & in-flight requests:
- Failover behavior is policy-driven. For regional failures we route to another healthy pool/variant and replay requests where safe. In-flight request behavior depends on stage: requests that already committed to a GPU kernel will either finish (if reachable) or return a platform-level 5xx. We capture those in metrics and mark them as retriable where appropriate.
- KV/cache: we support prefix/KV caching per-pool; when failing over to a variant without cache you’ll see cold-start latency for repeated prefixes. We include cache-miss metrics in the dashboard.

3) Error budget reporting / SLA credits:
- We provide daily export of SLO burn and a per-route export (CSV/JSON). SLA credits are calculated monthly against the committed availability (we typically publish 99.9% for hosted, 99.95% for Dedicated with contractual credits).

Next: Marcus 

 can you confirm observability hooks and suggested test metrics/panel we should ask Acme to check?

Thanks,
Marissa

Tagged a quick draft below for the POC. Happy to run the sandbox tests with Acme.

Test configuration (recommended POC):
- Environment: Dedicated sandbox project (isolated pool) we can spin up with 4x A100-equivalent GPUs.
- Throughput profile: steady 250 rps for 30m, spike test to 2k rps for 30s, sustained 1k rps for 10m, region-failover test by disabling primary region for 60s.
- SLOs / thresholds: availability target = 99.95% during POC window (monthly equivalent), pass if observed availability >= 99.9% during test window and error budget burn < 50% for the week of testing.
- Rate limits: sandbox baseline configured to 1k rps with short burst to 4k rps (30s) for POC. Production Dedicated can be tuned with contractual commits.

Observability hooks to provide to Acme:
- Metrics: http_requests_total (by status class), http_request_duration_seconds (p50/p95/p99), tokens_consumed_total, cache_hit_ratio, error_budget_burn_rate
- Exports: daily SLO burn CSV to their S3 / webhook, and an on-demand full trace export for any incident windows.

Failover behavior notes:
- In-flight requests: we mark and surface which requests failed due to region-level routing vs model execution failures. We will surface request IDs so Acme can correlate traces.
- Cache: expect cold-start penalty when moving to a pool without warmed KV cache (~50-200ms per repeated prompt depending on model).

I'll prepare a short runbook and a Grafana panel JSON we can share.
